doc-attribute.name: title
doc-attribute.brief: The title of the object

doc-attribute.name: name
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the object

doc-attribute.name: ingroup
doc-attribute.brief: The key of the group to which the object belongs to. All objects except the index group must belong to some group

doc-attribute.name: brief
doc-attribute.brief: A brief (one-two sentence) summary of the object

doc-attribute.name: key
doc-attribute.brief: The unique key of the article (must be unique among articles, groups and classes)

doc-attribute.name: if
doc-attribute.brief: A name of the definition to be set in the doc project file in order to include the object into the documentation. The value is optional. If no value is set, the object will be always included

doc-attribute.name: transform
doc-attribute.brief: A flag indicating whether the content contains BB-codes

doc-attribute.name: aliasId
doc-attribute.brief: The alias of article for HtmlHelp topic list

doc-attribute.name: excludeFromList
doc-attribute.brief: The flag indicating whether the article should not be displayed in the list of the articles in the group and content tree

doc-attribute.name: parent
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the parent class. Note: it is not a key to a parent class in the documentation, just an arbitrary text

doc-attribute.name: import
doc-attribute.brief: The flag indicating that the class must also display members of another classes (e.g. to use it include parent's class members)

doc-attribute.name: sig
doc-attribute.brief: A signature of the class

doc-attribute.name: prefix
doc-attribute.brief: A prefix for the class name

doc-attribute.name: type
doc-attribute.brief: A type of the class. The types interpretation depends on the template used.

doc-attribute.name: membersToContent
doc-attribute.brief: The flag indicating whether members of the class needs to be exposed in the content tree

doc-attribute.name: sort
doc-attribute.brief: The flag indicating whether the members needs to be sorted by the name ("yes" by default)

doc-attribute.name: declname
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the class to be used in declarations (the same as the class name by default)

doc-attribute.name: writeSignatures
doc-attribute.brief:
The flag indicating whether the signatures (aka name plus parameters) of the methods will be added to the list of the methods and constructors in the class.
The option is useful for classes with lot of overloads.

doc-element.brief: A specification of a method for a language specific declaration

doc-attribute.name: language
doc-attribute.brief: The programming language

doc-attribute.name: name
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the member. By default is equal to the name of the member

doc-attribute.name: prefix
doc-attribute.brief: The prefix to put before the declaration

doc-attribute.name: custom
doc-attribute.brief: A fully custom declaration

doc-attribute.name: suffix
doc-attribute.brief: A suffix to put after the declaration

doc-attribute.name: name-suffix
doc-attribute.brief: A suffix to add to the name of the member in declaration

doc-attribute.name: params
doc-attribute.brief: The parameter list

doc-attribute.name: return
doc-attribute.brief: The return value

doc-element.brief: A tab in the example item.

doc-attribute.name: title
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the tab

doc-attribute.name: highlight
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the programming language to do the syntax highlighting (if supported by the output template)

doc-attribute.name: title
doc-attribute.brief: A title of the example

doc-attribute.name: show
doc-attribute.brief: A flag indicating if the example must be fully displayed by default (for output templates that supports collapsing of the examples)

doc-attribute.name: gray
doc-attribute.brief: A flag indicating whether the example must be displayed on gray background

doc-attribute.name: tabs
doc-attribute.brief:
A flag indicating whether the example tag contains the text in its body or has one or more tab.
Please note that if tabs are enabled all the content must be in the tabs!

doc-attribute.name: highlight
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the programming language to do the syntax highlighting (if supported by the output template)

doc-element.brief: A description of the exception thrown by the method

doc-attribute.name: name
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the exception

doc-element.brief: A group of articles, classes and other groups

doc-attribute.name: importhhc
doc-attribute.brief: A name of the custom HTML HELP content file to be added to the group content

doc-attribute.name: importhhk
doc-attribute.brief: A name of the custom HTML HELP keywords file to be added to the group content

doc-attribute.name: sortarticles
doc-attribute.brief: A flag indicating whether articles needs to be sorted by the name

doc-attribute.name: sortgroups
doc-attribute.brief: A flag indicating whether groups needs to be sorted by the name

doc-attribute.name: sortclasses
doc-attribute.brief: A flag indicating whether classes needs to be sorted by the name

doc-attribute.name: order
doc-attribute.brief: If the value is set to "custom" the documentation won't do any grouping or sorting of the objects inside the group

doc-attribute.name: level
doc-attribute.brief: The level of the header (1 to 4)

doc-attribute.name: type
doc-attribute.brief: The type of the list (e.g. num). If type isn't set, the list will be a bulleted list

doc-attribute.name: name
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the member

doc-attribute.name: sig
doc-attribute.brief: A platform-specific signature of the member (e.g. for .NET type)

doc-attribute.name: visibility
doc-attribute.brief: Visibility of the member (e.g. public, protected)

doc-attribute.name: scope
doc-attribute.brief: The scope of the member (static or instance)

doc-attribute.name: type
doc-attribute.brief: The type of the member (e.g. field, property, method)

doc-attribute.name: divisor
doc-attribute.brief: A divisor between the class name and method name to be used (a dot (.) by default)

doc-attribute.name: excludeFromList
doc-attribute.brief: The flag indicating whether the member must be excluded from list of members in the class

doc-element.brief: A parameter of a member of a class or of a generic class

doc-attribute.name: name
doc-attribute.brief: The name of the parameter

doc-attribute.name: gray
doc-attribute.brief: The flag indicating that the parameter must be displayed on highlighted background

doc-element.brief: A value returned from a class
A see-also reference to another topic

doc-attribute.name: key
doc-attribute.brief: The key to which the see also refers to

doc-attribute.name: title
doc-attribute.brief: The title to display

doc-attribute.name: width
doc-attribute.brief: The width of the table in percents

doc-attribute.name: width
doc-attribute.brief: The width of the column in percents

doc-attribute.name: header
doc-attribute.brief: The flag indicating whether the row is a header row of the table
